The 2026 Openfront World Cup is the biggest tournament of the year 2026, bringing the best of Openfront on a World Cup style format of Trios.

About

Format

  • Group Stage - May 16th & 17th, 2026
    • 4 trio matches played using a match-point system in pools of 4, 6 pools in total
    • Teams earn points based on their maximum land size reached during each match
  • Point Distribution (per match)
      • 1st: 5 points
      • 2nd: 3 points
      • 3rd: 1 point
      • 4th: 0 points


    • Top two teams of each group advance to the 2026 Openfront Spring Major. The 4 best 3rd place teams also advance
  • Scoring Method
    • At the end of each match, referees record the largest territory size each team reached at any moment during the game
    • Teams are ranked using this maximum land value, and points are awarded accordingly
  • Tie-Breaker Rule
    • In case of equal points, they are decided by overall wins or domination over the other team they are tied with.

Prize Pool

  • Unique Pattern – awarded to all teams that advanced the group stage
  • In-Game currency - Caps for group stage, Plutonium for Finals
  • Clan Store - for winning clan
  • Custom Nation Flag - for Finalists
  • The following is awarded to the winners of the event in addition to the previous items:
    • Unique Bomb Pattern
    • Custom 1/1 skins

About

The Apex Assembly Cup is a tournament hosted by soothxng and Vlyra, players for Cynosure. It is a versus type tournament where one player or one team will compete individually against another player or team respectively. Tournament organization was aided by Zilka, a member of Cynosure.

Format

  • All teams entered through registration.
  • Stage One
    • Each trios will be divided into single players for the first stage.
    • Every appointed team leader from each trio will be responsible for assigning their teammates to a group of three players, the order of which is determined by randomization.
      • Groups will play a single round-robin format with every win gaining 2 points for the team, with a total of 12 potential points across all players and groups for a team.
  • Stage Two
    • Points from the prior stage will seed now reunited trios seeded into two separate groups based on their points from the prior stage.
      • Groups will play a single round-robin format with every win gaining 4 points, with a total of 16 potential points, plus the points earned from the previous stage.
  • Stage Three
    • The top 4 teams from the prior stage will compete for the top 4 placements in the tournament.

As the second edition of the Tournament of Brilliance series, the event features up to 100 players competing individually across a rotation of maps. Players accumulate points based on their match placements and in-game performance over the course of two days to determine the final standings.

Format

General

  • Game Mode: Free-for-All (FFA)
  • Players: 100
  • Dates: November 1st and 2nd

Map Rotation

The following 5 maps were played in this exact rotation on each matchday:

  • Pluto
  • Africa
  • Gateway
  • Asia
  • Europe

Scoring System

Players earn points based on their placement in each match:

  • 1st place: 10 points
  • 2nd place: 7 points
  • 3rd place: 5 points
  • 4th place: 3 points
  • 5th place: 1 point


In addition:

  • Each kill: 1 point
  • Final placement is determined by the largest territory size each player reached at any moment during a match, not by the end screen ranking.
  • Final rank ties are split according to average position.

Rules

  • No teaming
  • No ruination
  • No toxicity
  • No spawn killing
  • No MIRVs
